text:
alex: FYI hit a 95th p99 latency spike in the L4 canary this morning. Looks like runtime fell back to generic attention kernel mid-stream.
infra-bot: [ALERT] latency-spike - svc=inference-rt env=canary metric=p99 latency=1.3s ts=1968504321
maria: can you paste the request sample / model + seq_len?
alex: model=redwood-4x-small seq=1024 batch=1 route=prefer-tensorcore
jamal: probably the SM capability probe flipped. we saw a kernel error: "no_tensorcore_impl" and runtime selected generic_attention
jamal: log snippet:
```
W runtime: sm_probe: detected missing tc bfloat16 on L4
E runtime: kernel_select: fallback to generic_attention v2
```
sophia: question: did the KV cache already warm? mid-stream fallbacks kill perf because cache format differs.
alex: yes KV cache had prefixes for 1 request. fallback forced a full recompile and cache flush.
raj: fwiw microbenchmarks show flash-attn on H100 >> A100 >> L4. L4 often can't use bfloat16 tc, so we need different kernel path + quant-friendly kernels.
raj: numbers from our bench (seq=1024, bs=1): H100=180 tok/ms, A100=140 tok/ms, L4=55 tok/ms
maria: ugh. so runtime probe is correct but too eager. we need a graceful downgrade w/out cache invalidation.
sophia: propose change: add "soft_gate" mode: if probe says missing feature, keep current kernel for existing KV layouts for N requests, only route new requests to generic. avoids mid-stream switch.
jamal: +1. also add preflight probe on session start RPC so we detect client capabilities before any token emitted.
alex: can we implement both without big runtime churn? rough patch: 1) preflight probe RPC 2) soft_gate counter per-session 3) metric for mid-stream switches
maria: patch outline:
```
- probe_rpc(session_id) -> capability_mask
- session.soft_gate_counter = 3
- on kernel_select: if soft_gate_counter>0 && kernel_incompatible_with_kv -> keep old kernel and decrement
```
raj: note: for L4 we should prefer quantized_attention kernels (int8/4bit) which keep same KV layout as generic. map hardware capability -> preferred kernel list.
alex: agree. add model->kernel preference table in catalog so we can pin per-model heuristics.
sophia: tests: add canary with seq=1024 step: induce probe failure and verify no mid-stream cache invalidation and p99 stays <600ms
jamal: I'll pick this up. estimated 3d for prototype + 1w for canary rollout
maria: create RFC-followup doc and add to architecture backlog. assign jamal owner, sophia reviewer, raj perf
alex: tagging eng-oncall to watch next canary: @eng-oncall :eyes:
infra-bot: deploy canary started: deploy_id=canary-1968504300 env=canary
sophia: small nit: also log which kernel variant was used per-request (kernel_id) so we can correlate.
alex: agreed. add metric: runtime.kernel_switch.count and runtime.kernel_used{kernel_id}
maria: thanks all. jamal, please post follow-up PR link here when ready :thumbsup:
jamal: will do. PR draft by EOD.
